SAKURAMOD-GENERIC.manifestPrompt: Choose a Clear Card to manifest.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_GALE.title: Gale
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_GALE.description:
[gold]Windy[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
After you play {PlaysUntilDraw:diff()} more Gale cards this combat, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Add {ExtraCopies:diff()} [red]Forgotten[/red] [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Gale+|Gale}[/gold] copies into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_REFLECT.title: Reflect
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_FLIGHT.title: Flight
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_ACTION.title: Action
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_ACTION.description:
[gold]Windy[/gold]
Exhaust 1 card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
[gold]Manifest[/gold] {Cards:diff()}. {Cards:plural:It costs|They cost} 0 this turn.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Draw {ExtraDraw:diff()} {ExtraDraw:plural:card|cards}.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_APPEAR.title: Appear
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_AQUA.title: Aqua
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_AQUA.description:
[gold]Watery[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Draw 1 card for each enemy with [gold]Frostbite[/gold].
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Also gain {Energy:diff()} [gold]Energy[/gold] for each.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_BLADE.title: Blade
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_BLADE.description:
[gold]Fiery[/gold]
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage {Hits:diff()} times.
Each hit deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} more for every 2 Sword or Blade cards played this combat.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Hit 2 more times.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_HAIL.title: Hail
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_HAIL.description:
[gold]Watery[/gold]
Spend up to {Magic:diff()} [gold]Magic Charge[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies, plus {BonusDamage:diff()} per charge spent, and apply {SakuraFrostbitePower:diff()} [gold]Frostbite[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_LUCID.title: Lucid
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_LUCID.description:
[gold]Watery[/gold]
Look at the top {Look:diff()} cards of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
Put 1 into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Your next Attack this turn ignores enemy [gold]Block[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SHADE.title: Shade
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SHADE.description:
[gold]Watery[/gold]
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Retain your [gold]Block[/gold] until next turn.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SIEGE.title: Siege
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SIEGE.description:
[gold]Earthy[/gold]
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], plus 2 per enemy.
At the end of the enemy turn, if you still have [gold]Block[/gold], apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Also deal damage equal to that [gold]Block[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SWING.title: Swing
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SWING.description:
[gold]Earthy[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
This turn, your Attacks, including this one, deal double damage to [gold]Weak[/gold] enemies.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Triple instead.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_BREAK.title: Break
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_BREAK.description:
[gold]Fiery[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the enemy has [gold]Block[/gold], remove it first and deal double damage.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Remove 1 [gold]Artifact[/gold] and apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CHOICE.title: Choice
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CHOICE.description:
[gold]Fiery[/gold]
Choose one: [gold]Manifest[/gold] {ManifestCards:diff()}, costing 1 less this combat; or draw {DrawCards:diff()} {DrawCards:plural:card|cards}.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Do both.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CHOICE_DRAW_CHOICE.title: Draw
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_PROMISE.title: Promise
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_PROMISE.description:
[gold]Earthy[/gold]
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If you lose no HP before your next turn, draw {PromiseManifestPower:diff()} more cards and gain {PromiseManifestPower:diff()} [gold]Energy[/gold] at its start.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_STRUGGLE.title: Struggle
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_STRUGGLE.description:
[gold]Fiery[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Strength[/gold] affects this card twice.
Costs 1 less this turn for each other Attack you played this turn.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} more damage.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_BLAZE.title: Blaze
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_BLAZE.description:
[gold]Fiery[/gold]
Exhaust up to 3 other cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage, plus {ExtraDamage:diff()} per card in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold].
Then remove your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold] from combat.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Double the bonus.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_DREAMING.title: Dreaming
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_DREAMING.description:
[gold]Watery[/gold]
At the start of each turn, before you draw, choose a card in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and put it on top. It costs 0 that turn and gains [red]Forgotten[/red].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_GRAVITATION.title: Gravitation
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_GRAVITATION.description:
[gold]Earthy[/gold]
This turn, cards you play (except X-cost cards) return to your [gold]Hand[/gold] instead of your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold], costing 1 more each time they return.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Choose 1 card from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] and 1 from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. Put them into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_MIRAGE.title: Mirage
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_MIRAGE.description:
[gold]Watery[/gold]
Choose 1 enemy.
That enemy deals 0 attack damage next turn.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Affect ALL enemies instead.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_RECORD.title: Record
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_RECORD.description:
[gold]Watery[/gold]
Record up to 3 cards you play after this one this turn.
Next turn, add [red]Forgotten[/red] copies of them into your [gold]Hand[/gold], costing 0 that turn.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] This card does not Exhaust.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_EXCHANGE.title: Exchange
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_EXCHANGE.description:
[gold]Fiery[/gold]
Choose 2 cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Swap their [red]Forgotten[/red] states and costs this turn.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Swap the contents of 2 of: [gold]Memory[/gold], [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], [gold]Discard Pile[/gold], [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_KINDNESS.title: Kindness
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_KINDNESS.description:
[gold]Earthy[/gold]
This combat, cards you [gold]Manifest[/gold] no longer gain [red]Forgotten[/red]. [gold]Release[/gold] no longer grants [gold]Exhaust[/gold] or [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_LABYRINTH.title: Labyrinth
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_LABYRINTH.description:
[gold]Earthy[/gold]
ALL creatures take half damage from the first attack hit each turn. Damage from [gold]Earthy[/gold] cards is unaffected and does not consume this reduction.
The first [gold]Earthy[/gold] card you play each turn costs 1 less Energy.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_REPAIR.title: Repair
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_REPAIR.description:
[gold]Earthy[/gold]
Gain {RegenPower:diff()} [gold]Regeneration[/gold].
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Your [gold]Regeneration[/gold] no longer decreases at end of turn this combat.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_REVERSAL.title: Reversal
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_REVERSAL.description:
[gold]Windy[/gold]
Swap your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, plus {PileDamage:diff()} for every {PileCardsPerDamage:diff()} cards swapped.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Draw until your [gold]Hand[/gold] is full.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_REWIND.title: Rewind
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_REWIND.description:
[gold]Earthy[/gold]
Choose {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold] and put them into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
[gold]Extra:[/gold] They cost 0 this turn.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SNOOZE.title: Snooze
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SNOOZE.description:
[gold]Windy[/gold]
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] and {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} card.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Apply them to ALL enemies instead.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SPIRAL.title: Spiral
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SPIRAL.description:
[gold]Windy[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Damage and [gold]Block[/gold] increase by {MemoryScale:diff()} for each card in [gold]Memory[/gold].{IfUpgraded:show:
Next turn, before you draw, put {NextTurnCopies:diff()} [red]Forgotten[/red] [gold]Spiral[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].|}
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Add {ExtraCopies:diff()} [red]Forgotten[/red] [gold]Spirals[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. They cost 0 this turn.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_TRANSFER.title: Transfer
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_TRANSFER.description:
[gold]Windy[/gold]
An enemy loses {EnemyStrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
Gain {StrengthGain:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and {DexterityGain:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
[gold]Extra:[/gold] No longer [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_BLANK.title: Blank
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_BLANK.description:
[gold]Earthy[/gold]
Your Status and Curse cards gain [red]Forgotten[/red]. Next turn, draw 1 more card for each.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Remove your [gold]Debuffs[/gold] and enemies' [gold]Artifact[/gold], [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Dexterity[/gold] buffs.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_MIRROR.title: Mirror
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_MIRROR.description:
[gold]Watery[/gold]
Choose a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
It gains {Repeat:diff()} [gold]Replay[/gold] this combat.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] It gains {ExtraRepeat:diff()} additional [gold]Replay[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_REMIND.title: Remind
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_REMIND.description:
[gold]Fiery[/gold]
[gold]Remind[/gold] {Cards:diff()}.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Choose to add a [gold]Time[/gold] or [gold]Rewind[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It costs 1 less this turn.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SYNCHRONIZE.title: Synchronize
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SYNCHRONIZE.description:
[gold]Windy[/gold]
Choose 2 cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
This turn, when you play either one, automatically play the other.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_TIME.title: Time
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_TIME.description:
[gold]Fiery[/gold]
End your turn.
Take an extra turn.
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Keep your [gold]Hand[/gold], [gold]Block[/gold], unspent Energy and Element states for it.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_TRUE_OR_FALSE.title: True or False
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_TRUE_OR_FALSE.descriptio:
[gold]Fiery[/gold]
Choose one: give another card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] [red]Forgotten[/red] and draw {Cards:diff()} cards, or [gold]Stabilize[/gold] 1 and gain {Energy:diff()} [gold]Energy[/gold].
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Do both.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_TRUE_OR_FALSE_DRAW_CHOIC:
Another card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] gains [red]Forgotten[/red].
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_SWORD.title: Sword
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_SWORD.title: Sword
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_SWORD.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Fiery[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and extra damage equal to {Magic:diff()}% of the enemy's current HP.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_SHIELD.title: Shield
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_SHIELD.title: Shield
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_SHIELD.descriptio:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Fiery[/gold]
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Gain additional [gold]Block[/gold] equal to {Magic:diff()}% of your current HP.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_JUMP.title: Jump
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_JUMP.title: Jump
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_JUMP.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Windy[/gold]
At the start of your turn, remove {Magic:diff()} random [gold]{Magic:plural:Debuff|Debuffs}[/gold] from yourself.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_ILLUSION.title: Illusion
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_ILLUSION.descriptio:
[gold]Windy[/gold]
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], plus {Magic:diff()} for every 3 cards in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_ILLUSION.title: Illusion
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_MIST.title: Mist
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_MIST.title: Mist
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_MIST.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Earthy[/gold]
Remove all enemy [gold]Block[/gold].
At the start of your turn, apply {NoxiousFumesPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_RAIN.title: Rain
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_RAIN.description:
[gold]Watery[/gold]
All cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] cost 1 less this turn.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_RAIN.title: Rain
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_RAIN.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Watery[/gold]
Randomly choose up to {Magic:diff()} cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
They cost 0 this combat.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_SWEET.title: Sweet
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_SWEET.title: Sweet
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_SWEET.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Fiery[/gold]
At the start of each player's turn, they heal {Magic:diff()}% of their max HP.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_VOICE.title: Voice
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_VOICE.description:
[gold]Windy[/gold] [gold]Invisible[/gold]
Add a copy of this card into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
At the end of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Echo[/gold] {Magic:diff()}.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_VOICE.title: Voice
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_VOICE.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Windy[/gold]
At the start of your turn, add {Magic:diff()} Voice into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_CLOUD.title: Cloud
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_CLOUD.description:
[gold]Watery[/gold]
Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], plus {CalculationExtra:diff()} per [gold]Watery card[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold].
In [gold]Watery state[/gold], add a Clow Rain into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It costs 0 this turn.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_CLOUD.title: Cloud
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_CLOUD.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Watery[/gold]
Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], plus {CalculationExtra:diff()} per [gold]Watery card[/gold] in your deck.
Add a Clow Rain into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It costs 0 this combat.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_FLOWER.title: Flower
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_FLOWER.description:
[gold]Earthy[/gold]
Gain {Energy:diff()} Energy.
In [gold]Earthy state[/gold], this card does not Exhaust.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_FLOWER.title: Flower
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_FLOWER.descriptio:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Earthy[/gold]
Gain {Energy:diff()} Energy.
If you are in [gold]Earthy state[/gold], this card does not Exhaust when played.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_EARTHY.title: Earthy
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_EARTHY.description:
[gold]Earthy[/gold]
Add {Magic:diff()} [gold]Lei Di[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Enter [gold]Earthy state[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_EARTHY.title: Earthy
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_FIREY.title: Fiery
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_FIREY.description:
[gold]Fiery[/gold]
Add {Magic:diff()} [gold]Huo Shen[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Enter [gold]Fiery state[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_FIREY.title: Fiery
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_WATERY.title: Watery
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_WATERY.description:
[gold]Watery[/gold]
Add {Magic:diff()} [gold]Shui Long[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Enter [gold]Watery state[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_WATERY.title: Watery
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_WINDY.title: Windy
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_WINDY.description:
[gold]Windy[/gold]
Add {Magic:diff()} [gold]Feng Hua[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Enter [gold]Windy state[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_WINDY.title: Windy
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_WAVE.title: Wave
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_WAVE.description:
[gold]Watery[/gold]
Whenever you play an Attack, gain {Magic:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_WAVE.title: Wave
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_WAVE.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Watery[/gold]
Enter all four element states.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_BIG.title: Big
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_BIG.title: Big
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_BIG.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Fiery[/gold]
Your attacks deal 66% more damage.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_BUBBLES.title: Bubbles
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_BUBBLES.description:
[gold]Watery[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Remove 1 random [gold]dispellable buff[/gold] from the enemy.{IfUpgraded:show:
If successful and you have Sealed Book, gain {Magic:diff()} [gold]Magic Charge[/gold].|}
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_BUBBLES.extraDescri: [gold]Extra:[/gold] Remove all of its [gold]dispellable buffs[/gold] instead.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_BUBBLES.title: Bubbles
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_BUBBLES.descripti:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Watery[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Remove all [gold]dispellable buffs[/gold] from ALL enemies.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_CREATE.title: Create
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_CREATE.description:
[gold]Earthy[/gold] [gold]Windy[/gold] [gold]Removable[/gold]. [gold]Cost-Decreasing[/gold]. [gold]Entity-Limited[/gold].
Add {Relics:diff()} random relic to the combat rewards.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_CREATE.title: Create
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_CREATE.descriptio:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Earthy[/gold] [gold]Windy[/gold] [gold]Removable[/gold].
Add {Relics:diff()} relics to this combat's rewards: 1 random and 1 character relic.
Your next 3 Elite or Boss victories this run each give 1 extra character relic.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_RETURN.title: Return
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_RETURN.title: Return
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_RETURN.descriptio:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Watery[/gold] [gold]Removable[/gold]
Restore all health and return 75% of the charge consumed by the last convert ({Magic:diff()}).
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_DREAM.title: Dream
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_DREAM.description:
[gold]Windy[/gold]
Add {Cards:diff()} random {Cards:plural:[gold]Clow Card[/gold]|[gold]Clow Cards[/gold]} into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. {Cards:plural:It costs|They cost} 0 this turn.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_DREAM.title: Dream
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_DREAM.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Windy[/gold]
Convert [gold]Clow Cards[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into [gold]Sakura Cards[/gold] until end of turn.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_DARK.title: Dark
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_DARK.description:
[gold]Windy[/gold] [gold]Watery[/gold]
At the end of your turn, you may Exhaust up to {Magic:diff()} cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. If you do, gain 1 Energy next turn.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_DARK.title: Dark
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_DARK.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Windy[/gold] [gold]Watery[/gold]
At the end of your turn, Exhaust any number of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Add that many random upgraded [gold]Clow Cards[/gold] into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_MIRROR.title: Mirror
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_MIRROR.selectionPro: Choose a non-Spell card to copy.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_MIRROR.description:
[gold]Watery[/gold]
Choose {Copies:diff()} non-[gold]Spell[/gold] card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] and copy it.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_MIRROR.title: Mirror
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_MIRROR.selectionP: Choose a Clow Card or Clear Card.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_MIRROR.descriptio:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Watery[/gold]
Choose 1 [gold]Clow Card[/gold] or [gold]Clear Card[/gold] and add a copy of it into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_LITTLE.title: Little
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_LITTLE.title: Little
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_LITTLE.descriptio:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Watery[/gold]
You take 33% less attack damage.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_LOCK.title: Lock
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_LOCK.description:
[gold]Fiery[/gold]
Exhaust up to {Magic:diff()} cards.
Gain 1 [gold]Magic Charge[/gold] for each exhausted card.
[gold]Unreal[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_LOCK.title: Lock
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_LOCK.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Fiery[/gold]
The next time you trigger a [gold]Magic Charge[/gold] effect, do not spend Magic Charge.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_LOOP.title: Loop
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_LOOP.description:
[gold]Earthy[/gold]
At the start of your turn, draw {Cards:diff()} card, then discard up to {Cards:diff()} card.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_LOOP.title: Loop
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_LOOP.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Earthy[/gold]
Whenever you discard a card, draw {Cards:diff()} card.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_POWER.title: Power
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_POWER.title: Power

SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_MAZE.title: Maze
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_SAND.title: Sand
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_SAND.title: Sand
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_SAND.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Earthy[/gold]
Trigger [gold]Poison[/gold] on ALL enemies {Triggers:diff()} times.
Then apply {PoisonPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies {Applications:diff()} times.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_SHOT.title: Shot
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_SHOT.title: Shot
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_SHADOW.title: Shadow
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_SHADOW.title: Shadow

SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_DASH.title: Dash
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_DASH.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Windy[/gold]
Draw until your [gold]Hand[/gold] is full.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_FLY.title: Fly
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_FLY.title: Fly
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_FLY.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Windy[/gold]
At the start of your turn, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_GLOW.title: Glow
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_GLOW.description:
[gold]Fiery[/gold]
Draw {Cards:diff()} card.
If you have Sealed Book, gain {Magic:diff()} [gold]Magic Charge[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_GLOW.title: Glow
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_GLOW.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Fiery[/gold]
At the start of your turn, gain {Magic:diff()} [gold]Magic Charge[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_LIBRA.title: Libra
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_LIBRA.description:
[gold]Fiery[/gold]
If you have no [gold]Block[/gold], spend up to {Magic:diff()} [gold]Magic Charge[/gold] and gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] twice.
Otherwise, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_LIBRA.title: Libra
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_LIBRA.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Fiery[/gold]
Spend all [gold]Magic Charge[/gold].
For each spent, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
For every {Magic:diff()} spent, gain {Energy:diff()} [gold]Energy[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_LIGHT.title: Light
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_LIGHT.description:
[gold]Earthy[/gold] [gold]Fiery[/gold]
Increase your maximum hand size by 2.
[gold]Void[/gold] no longer makes you lose Energy.{IfUpgraded:show:
You can play [gold]Void[/gold]. When played, it Exhausts and you draw 1 card.|}
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_LIGHT.title: Light
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_LIGHT.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Earthy[/gold] [gold]Fiery[/gold]
You can play Status and Curse cards. They Exhaust when played.
Whenever you play one, draw 1 card and heal 1 HP.
[gold]Void[/gold] no longer makes you lose Energy.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_CHANGE.title: Change
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_CHANGE.description:
[gold]Earthy[/gold]
You may discard a card. If you do, draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Spend up to {Magic:diff()} [gold]Magic Charge[/gold]. Draw 1 card for each spent.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_CHANGE.title: Change
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_ARROW.title: Arrow
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_ARROW.description:
[gold]Fiery[/gold]
Discard any number of cards.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy X times, plus once for each card discarded.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_ARROW.title: Arrow
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_ARROW.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Fiery[/gold]
Discard your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
For each unique card discarded, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_MOVE.title: Move
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_MOVE.extraDescripti: [gold]Extra:[/gold] Put 2 additional Empty Spells into it.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_MOVE.title: Move
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_MOVE.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Fiery[/gold]
At the start of your turn, add {Magic:diff()} Empty Spell into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_FIGHT.title: Fight
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_FIGHT.description:
[gold]Earthy[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain 1 [gold]Magic Charge[/gold] and {Magic:diff()} temporary [gold]Strength[/gold].
Add a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Fight+|Fight}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_FIGHT.title: Fight
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_FIGHT.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Earthy[/gold]
Add a [red]Forgotten[/red] [gold]Fight+[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
At the start of each turn, add another.
Your [gold]Fight[/gold] cards grant 1 more temporary [gold]Strength[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_FLOAT.title: Float
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_FLOAT.description:
[gold]Windy[/gold]
Whenever you draw a card, gain {Magic:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_FLOAT.title: Float
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_FLOAT.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Windy[/gold]
Whenever you gain Block, gain {Magic:diff()} additional Block.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_FREEZE.title: Freeze
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_FREEZE.title: Freeze
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_FREEZE.descriptio:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Watery[/gold]
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Apply {SakuraFrostbitePower:diff()} [gold]Frostbite[/gold], plus {ExtraFrostbite:diff()} more if the target isn't an Elite or Boss.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_STORM.title: Storm
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_STORM.description:
[gold]Windy[/gold]
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage {Magic:diff()} times.
Each hit deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} more for each [gold]Windy card[/gold] you played before this one this turn.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_STORM.title: Storm
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_STORM.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Windy[/gold]
Random enemies take {Magic:diff()} hits of {Damage:diff()} to {MaxDamage:diff()} damage.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_THROUGH.title: Through
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_THROUGH.description:
[gold]Earthy[/gold]
Gain [gold]Through[/gold].
[gold]Through[/gold]'s bonus damage is {Rate:diff()}% of your Magic Charge.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_THROUGH.title: Through
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_ERASE.title: Erase
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_ERASE.description:
[gold]Windy[/gold]
If the target is a minion, or a normal enemy at or below {KillPercent:diff()}% HP, kill it.
Otherwise, deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_ERASE.title: Erase
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_ERASE.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Windy[/gold]
Normal enemy: at the end of each of its turns, it loses {Percent:diff()}% of its Max HP.
Elite or Boss: it loses {MaxHpLoss:diff()} Max HP.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_SILENT.title: Silent
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_SILENT.description:
[gold]Watery[/gold]
Gain 1 [gold]Buffer[/gold].
Next turn, you cannot play Attack cards.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_SILENT.title: Silent
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_SLEEP.title: Sleep
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_SLEEP.title: Sleep
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_WOOD.title: Wood
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_WOOD.description:
[gold]Earthy[/gold]
Gain {ThornsPower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold].
At the start of each enemy turn, enemies without [gold]Poison[/gold] gain {PoisonPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold]; poisoned enemies lose {StrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] that turn.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_WOOD.title: Wood
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_WOOD.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Earthy[/gold]
Gain {ThornsPower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold].
At the start of each enemy turn, ALL enemies gain {PoisonPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold] and lose {StrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] that turn.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_SONG.title: Song
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_SONG.description:
[gold]Windy[/gold]
Exhaust up to X+1 cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies for each card Exhausted.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_SONG.title: Song
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_SONG.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Windy[/gold]
Exhaust any number of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
For each, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies and gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_SNOW.title: Snow
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_SNOW.description:
[gold]Watery[/gold]
Deal {SnowDamage:diff()} damage to a random enemy for each [gold]Watery card[/gold] played this combat ({Magic:diff()} {Magic:plural:time|times}).
Each hit applies 1 [gold]Frostbite[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_SNOW.extraDescripti: [gold]Extra:[/gold] Also deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_SNOW.title: Snow
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_SNOW.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Watery[/gold]
Deal {SnowDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies for each [gold]Watery card[/gold] played this combat ({Magic:diff()} {Magic:plural:time|times}).
Each hit applies 1 [gold]Frostbite[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_THUNDER.title: Thunder
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_THUNDER.description:
[gold]Earthy[/gold]
Can only be played with 10 [gold]Magic Charge[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_THUNDER.extraDescri:
[gold]Extra:[/gold] Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy {Magic:diff()} times.
Add a [gold]Void[/gold] into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_THUNDER.title: Thunder
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_THUNDER.descripti:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Earthy[/gold]
Spend all Energy and [gold]Magic Charge[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy once per Energy and once per {Magic:diff()} [gold]Magic Charge[/gold] spent.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_TIME.title: Time
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_TIME.description:
[gold]Watery[/gold]
At the end of this turn, keep your [gold]Hand[/gold], [gold]Block[/gold], unspent Energy and Element states for next turn.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_TIME.title: Time
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_TIME.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Watery[/gold]
Apply {ClassicTimePower:diff()} [gold]Time[/gold] to ALL enemies, ignoring [gold]Artifact[/gold].
Add 1 [gold]Void[/gold] into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_TWIN.title: Twin
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_TWIN.description:
[gold]Fiery[/gold] [gold]Watery[/gold]
The next [gold]Clow Card[/gold] you play each turn is played twice.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_TWIN.title: Twin
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_TWIN.description:
[gold]Sakura Card[/gold] [gold]Fiery[/gold] [gold]Watery[/gold]
[gold]Clow Cards[/gold] cost {Amount:diff()} more this combat and are played {Amount:diff()} additional {Amount:plural:time|times}.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_CLOW_NOTHING.title: Nothing
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_LOVE.title: Love
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_HOPE.title: Hope
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SAKURA_HOPE.description: All your normal damage and [gold]Block[/gold] are doubled this combat.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_ANOTHER_ME.title: Another Me
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_ANOTHER_ME.description:
Gain {Magic:diff()} [gold]Magic Charge[/gold].
Whenever Magic Charge is spent to activate an [gold]Extra[/gold] effect, refund {Magic:diff()} [gold]Magic Charge[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_GROWING_MAGIC.title: Growing Magic
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_GROWING_MAGIC.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If this kills a non-minion enemy, gain {Magic:diff()} [gold]Magic Charge[/gold] and Sealed Wand gains 2 extra charge.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SPELL_SEAL.title: Seal
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SPELL_SEAL.description:
[gold]Spell[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If this kills a monster, Sealed Wand gains 2 additional charge.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SPELL_RELEASE.title: Release
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SPELL_RELEASE.descriptio:
[gold]Spell[/gold].
Choose a [gold]Clow Card[/gold], [gold]Sakura Card[/gold], or [gold]Clear Card[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
It costs 0 this turn, all its numbers increase by 50% this combat, and it gains [gold]Ethereal[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Each card can only be [gold]Released[/gold] once per combat.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SPELL_TURN.title: Turn
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SPELL_TURN.selectionProm: Choose a Clow Card to turn into Sakura.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SPELL_TURN.description:
[gold]Spell[/gold] [gold]Purge[/gold].
Choose a [gold]Clow Card[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It becomes its [gold]Sakura Card[/gold], both in your [gold]Hand[/gold] and permanently in your deck.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SPELL_EMPTY_SPELL.title: Empty Spell
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SPELL_EMPTY_SPELL.descri:
[gold]Spell[/gold].
Choose 1 of Huo Shen, Lei Di, Feng Hua, or Shui Long and add it into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SPELL_HUO_SHEN.title: Huo Shen
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SPELL_LEI_DI.title: Lei Di
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SPELL_LEI_DI.description:
[gold]Spell[/gold] [gold]Earthy[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SPELL_FENG_HUA.title: Feng Hua
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_SPELL_SHUI_LONG.title: Shui Long
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_MICRO_LIGHT.title: Micro Light
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_MICRO_LIGHT.description:
Reduce the Dark's [gold]Darkness[/gold] by {DarknessPower:diff()} (minimum 1).
Cannot gain [red]Forgotten[/red].
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_BALANCE.title: Balance
SAKURA_MOD_CARD_BALANCE.description:
Move both Libra pans 1 point toward 5.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold].
